sources: Authored in-house for three.ws on 2026-11-16. Every prompt and expected answer is original; no benchmark, dataset or third-party text was copied.
notes: Objective, single-answer tasks so a model can be graded without an LLM judge. `expect` grades quality (answer correct, tolerant of formatting); `format` grades adherence to the output contract the prompt states.

items.prompt: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with the number only.
A shop sells pencils at 3 for 45 cents. How many cents do 12 pencils cost? Reply with the number only.
What is 2 to the power of 10, minus 24? Reply with the number only.
Ana is taller than Ben. Ben is taller than Caro. Who is the shortest? Reply with the name only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 10 days from now? Reply with the day only.
A box holds 4 red balls and 6 blue balls. What fraction of the balls are red, in lowest terms? Reply with the fraction only, like 1/2.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Reply with the symbol only.
How many sides does a hexagon have? Reply with the number only.
Which planet in our solar system is closest to the Sun? Reply with the name only.
In a 3D file format, what does the letter B in GLB stand for? Reply with one word.
Return a JSON object with exactly two keys: "name" set to "robot" and "legs" set to the integer 4. Output only the JSON, no code fences, no prose.

Extract the city and the year from this sentence and return them as JSON with keys "city" (string) and "year" (integer): "The studio opened its second office in Lisbon in 2024." Output only the JSON, no code fences, no prose.

Classify the sentiment of this review as positive, negative or neutral and return JSON with a single key "sentiment": "The avatar loaded instantly and the lip sync looked great." Output only the JSON, no code fences, no prose.
Return a JSON array of the first five prime numbers, as integers. Output only the JSON, no code fences, no prose.
Write the word cat in uppercase letters, three times, separated by single commas with no spaces. Output nothing else.
List three primary colours of light, one per line, lowercase, with no numbering, bullets or other text.
Reverse the letters of the word avatar. Reply with the reversed word only.
Answer with exactly one word, yes or no: is 91 a prime number?
Summarise in at most 12 words: "The forge lane turns a text prompt into a textured 3D model, then checks the render with a vision model before it is saved, so broken meshes never reach the gallery."
What does this JavaScript expression evaluate to: [1, 2, 3].map((n) => n * 2).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)? Reply with the number only.
In JavaScript, what does typeof null return? Reply with the exact string value only, without quotes.
How many milliseconds are in 2.5 seconds? Reply with the number only.
A 3D scene runs at 60 frames per second. How many frames does it render in 90 seconds? Reply with the number only.
Translate the English word "house" into Spanish. Reply with the single Spanish word only.
